snippet.title: Slumber Realm - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A dreamy dice roguelike. Enter the Slumber Realm and battle your adolescent fears. Discover powerful synergies, unlock upgrades and equipment, fight broccoli. Decorate your crib with relics of the 90s. Grab your trusty d6 and journey into a dreamy ’90s-infused turn-based roguelike. Create wild synergies with loads of unlockable gear and roll for victory in snappy 30-minute runs.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325390/Slumber_Realm/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
